homepageEdition: Paper record sleeves / five catalogue entries
scope: JIE LAN is reconstructed against the supplied reference front: upright kale, visible weathered wood and flax, handwritten paper, curved blue porcelain, hanging sage and rose linen, warm glass and fine botanical orbits. Two generated material atlases texture actual independent meshes. POEM retains its round sculpture and fixes CDN-dependent startup with same-origin Three.js and honest slow-load handling. The other three artworks, articles and five-world order are preserved.
jielanInteraction: Real orbit, zoom and independent front/side/back cameras; one-click reset clears rotation, material separation, study light and closeups. Camera-space bounds fitting preserves relative zoom on resize. Resource disposal and WebGL restoration are handled in the viewer.
interaction: Direct start and browsable index; optional session-only resume; desktop sticky chapters and contact-sheet directory; mobile bottom actions and directory sheet; explicit still/live modes; secondary 3D controls; filmstrip, image status, desktop arrows and keyboard, native dialog focus and same-URL Back-to-close.
mobilePresentation: Touch devices up to 900 CSS pixels still enter through high-resolution photographs, with explicit opt-in to the original 3D scenes. Page scrolling stays native; pinch and pan are restricted to the image viewer. Dynamic viewport and safe areas are accommodated. No automatic tour, audio, account or analytics.
images: JIE LAN and POEM have same-scene covers, independent closeups, side/back views and GLB snapshots with build manifests. The other three artwork bundles retain their existing bytes and scene editions. Generated material studies are not substitute whole-artwork front images.
modelLimitations: GLB files contain the existing static geometry/material snapshots, not webpage lighting, postprocessing, rain animation, audio or garden interaction.
referenceUse: Interaction/design references only. No third-party application code, images, fonts or branding copied.
